tools.description: Saves a new version of a site (a checkpoint on the Undo timeline). files = { path: base64_content }. label = a HUMAN sentence like 'Added the beach photos' — grandma reads this list. Idempotent: the same files return the same version. Returns { version: {id, seq, note}, created, speak, next_actions }.
tools.name: add_or_edit_files

tools.description: Puts a purchased domain on a site. If this rides a buy_domain bundle, pass the SAME confirm_token plus the full bundle_actions — the human's one yes covers both. Otherwise agents get their own confirm question. Returns { hostname_id, state, speak, state_proof, next_actions }.
tools.name: connect_domain_to_site

tools.description: The answer to "start a new website called X". Returns { site: {id, slug, state}, speak, state_proof, next_actions }. The site is a private draft until publish_site. SAFE TO RUN.
tools.name: create_site

tools.description: The full knob list of this service with trust tiers. Returns the capabilities manifest. SAFE TO RUN; also at /.well-known/windy-capabilities.json.
tools.name: get_capabilities

tools.description: The answer to "what am I building?" / "read me my projects". Returns { sites: [{id, slug, display_name, state, url, speak}], speak }.
tools.name: list_my_sites

tools.description: The Undo timeline for a site: every saved checkpoint with its human label. Returns { versions: [{id, seq, note, is_live, created_at}], speak }.
tools.name: list_versions

tools.description: Puts a version live. ALWAYS returns confirm_required first for agents: RELAY the question VERBATIM, then call again with the confirm_token after the human says yes (a spoken yes counts). Returns { deployment_id, state, speak, state_proof, next_actions } once confirmed. Publishing is explicit — drafts never leak.
tools.name: publish_site

tools.description: Deep repair: rewrites the edge pointer for a site's subdomain from database truth and purges the cache (KV is a cache; Postgres is truth). Safe to repeat. Gold+ standing required. Returns { hostname, rebuilt, speak }.
tools.name: rebuild_pointer

tools.description: Deep repair: re-runs the publish pipeline for the CURRENT live version (safe to repeat — desired state). Use when a site shows stale or missing content. Gold+ Eternitas standing required. Returns { deployment_id, state, speak, next_actions }.
tools.name: republish_site

tools.description: Windy Doctor for the sites service — use FIRST when anything seems wrong. Returns { checks: [{status, severity, finding, remediation}] } where remediation is a LITERAL next step. SAFE TO RUN.
tools.name: run_diagnostics

tools.description: The answer to "is my site up?". Returns { state, live_version_id, url, speak, state_proof, next_actions }. SAFE TO RUN — kept on an always-up path.
tools.name: site_status

tools.description: The giant Undo: puts an EARLIER version back live (rollback). Same confirm flow as publish_site. Returns the same shape.
tools.name: undo_to_version
